sessions.text:
User: I'm putting together a recipe card for my lemon loaf to hand out at the school bake sale.
Assistant: Lovely. What do you want on the card, and how should the quantities read?
User: The card has a title, the ingredients and three or four method steps. The oven part is the same as my banana bread card.
Assistant: Got it. Is there anything special about how the amounts should be written?
User: This time, give amounts in cups for this recipe card. Most of the parents only own cup measures.
Assistant: Cups for this card, noted. I'll draft it once you send the ingredient amounts.

User: Before we start on my pancake recipe, put an Allergens: line under every ingredient list you write. I cook for a lot of kids with allergies.
Assistant: Will do. Which recipe are we working on?
User: Pancakes for Sunday brunch. I stick to metric units for recipe amounts. Can you tidy my notes?
Assistant: Metric it is, grams and millilitres. Send the notes over when you have them.
User: Thanks. I'll send them tomorrow, I still need to buy the maple syrup.
